ElementDescription: The NDAR Global Unique Identifier (GUID) for research subject
Subject ID how it's defined in lab/project
Date on which the interview/genetic test/sampling/imaging/biospecimen was completed. MM/DD/YYYY
Age in months at the time of the interview/test/sampling/imaging.
Notes: Age is rounded to chronological month. If the research participant is 15-days-old at time of interview, the appropriate value would be 0 months. If the participant is 16-days-old, the value would be 1 month.
M = Male; F = Female; O=Other; NR = Not reported

ElementDescription: Is the participant able to do heavy work around the house, like shoveling snow or washing windows, walls, or floors without help? (Other examples: scrub floors, wash windows, rake leaves, mow lawn)
Is the participant able to walk half a mile without help (about 4-6 blocks)? (Other example: walk one half mile or 4-6 blocks without stopping for more than 5 minutes)
Is the participant able to walk up and down one flight of stairs without help?
Was the questionnaire completed by the participant themselves or by a proxy informant?
Is there any physical condition, illness, or health problem that bothers you now?
Which of these things are you still healthy enough to do without help?
Notes: 1= Heavy work around the house, like shoveling snow or washing walls; 2= (Men) Work at a full-time job; 3= (Women) Do the ordinary work around the house yourself; 4= Walk half a mile (about eight ordinary blocks); 5= Go out to a movie, to church or a meeting, or to visit friends; 6= Walk up and down stairs to the second floor

ElementDescription: Which of these statements fits you best?
Notes: 1= I cannot work (keep house) at all now because of my health; 2= I have to limit some of the work or other things that I do; 3= I am not limited in any of my activities
